title: Screen: open the drying page by itself when drying is started from somewhere else (for example from Fluidd)
note: Off by default. Install with: --with screen-drying-autoshow. Where the screen program reads the drying state from the printer, a debug-log call is replaced by 23 instructions: when the state is 'drying', the page 'Page_Filament_Drying' is opened through the program's own thread-safe GUI queue, unless the drying page is already shown.
